posts.description: Micro.blog’s automated threading to Bluesky is fantastic. It’s a big step toward write-once-read-anywhere. I do a lot of cutting-and-pasting between Micro.blog, Mastodon, Bluesky, Tumblr, Facebook and occasionally LinkedIn and Reddit. It’s very inconvenient. I want to just be able to write and post once, to one place, and have it appear on those platforms or anywhere else people might want to foll

I tried Tripod , the new podcast app from Ben Rice Mccarthy, who previously developed the Indigo and Croissant apps for Mastodon and Bluesky; and the Obscura camera app. I like the way Tripod processes new episodes into an inbox, which can then be added to a queue or deleted.
